description: LedgerCloseWebhook subscribes an external HTTP endpoint to Stellar ledger-close events. The operator delivers a HMAC-SHA256-signed JSON payload to the endpoint within 5 seconds of each ledger close, with automatic exponential-backoff retries and delivery tracking.

url.description: Target URL that will receive POST requests with the ledger-close JSON payload.

secretRef.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret whose `value` key holds the HMAC signing secret used to compute the X-Stellar-Signature header. Omit to disable payload signing.

events.description: Ledger-close event types to subscribe to. Defaults to [LedgerClose].

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts after the first delivery failure. Retries use exponential back-off (1 s, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s, 16 s). Defaults to 5.

timeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for each individual attempt. Defaults to 5.

enabled.description: Set to false to pause delivery without deleting the resource.

lastDeliveredSequence.description: Ledger sequence number last successfully delivered.

lastDeliveredAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful delivery.

totalDelivered.description: Cumulative count of successfully delivered ledger-close events.

totalFailed.description: Cumulative count of delivery failures (all retries exhausted).

phase.description: Phase of the most-recent delivery attempt.

deliveryLog.description: Ring-buffer of the 20 most-recent delivery log entries.
